'''Bennykenobi 4 From Each LS Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bennykenobi]]
* '''Published:''' 5 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Docking Bay|Hoth-L-hothechodockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Hoth Echo Docking Bay Bennykenobi L.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a deck with 4 cards from each expansion Premiere through Theed Palace and 4 premium cards. The cards are listed by expansion. I've played it a couple of time with a friend of mine and his regular deck. It is 2-1 at this time. I know it's not perfect, but it was fun limiting myself in selecting the cards.

== Strategy ==

Not much of a strategy. Just hope your opponent doesn't have alot of space. There is alot of jank that won't break your heart when force drained (terrible strategy, but I can't think of anything else at this time.
